englishTranslation: Clay pot rice with caramelized fish
atAGlance: Cơm niêu cá kho pairs clay-pot rice with caramelized fish. The fish sauce, caramel, pepper, and rice are the point: salty-sweet sauce against plain rice.
whatItIs: Cơm niêu cá kho is clay-pot rice with caramelized fish. It puts two comforts together: hot rice and fish braised in fish-sauce caramel.
howToEnjoy: Use the rice to soften the salty-sweet fish sauce caramel. Ask about bones before ordering if you want an easier plate.
howLocalsOrder: Cơm niêu cá kho is a clay-pot rice order, good for sharing with braised or salty dishes. Ask whether the crispy rice is served at the table, and order extra rice if the table has strong fish-sauce caramel dishes.
worthKnowing: Cơm niêu means clay-pot rice; cá kho is the braised fish. Together, they read more like a sit-down comfort meal than a quick rice plate. In Vietnam, rice plates are everyday meals shaped by broken rice, scallion oil, pickles, fish-sauce caramel, and quick street-service habits.
goodToKnow: Cơm niêu means clay-pot rice, often prized for hot fluffy rice and crisp edges. Watch for fish bones in cá kho.
travelerCaution: May contain fish bones and fish sauce.
